stem: Which of the following occurred as a result of the Sherman Antitrust Act?

options.label: F
options.text: Workers secured a greater share of company profits.

options.label: G
options.text: The influence of labor unions on factory owners was reduced.

options.label: H
options.text: The federal government could dissolve business monopolies.

options.label: J
options.text: Businesses were required to pay fees to open overseas locations.
